arxiv-1909-08787.title: On Efficient Multilevel Clustering via Wasserstein Distances
arxiv-1909-08787.creator: Viet Huynh, Nhat Ho, Nhan Dam, XuanLong Nguyen, Mikhail Yurochkin, Hung Bui, Dinh Phung
arxiv-1909-08787.description: Abstract We propose a novel approach to the problem of multilevel clustering, which aims to simultaneously partition data in each group and discover grouping patterns among groups in a potentially large hierarchically structured corpus of data. Our method involves a joint optimization formulation over several spaces of discrete probability measures, which are endowed with Wasserstein distance metrics.

arxiv-2006-04832.title: Stochastic re-acceleration and magnetic-field damping in Tycho’s supernova remnant
arxiv-2006-04832.creator: A. Wilhelm ,, I. Telezhinsky, V.V. Dwarkadas, M. Pohl
arxiv-2006-04832.description: Abstract Context. Tycho’s supernova remnant (SNR) is associated with the historical supernova (SN) event SN 1572 of Type Ia. The explosion occurred in a relatively clean environment, and was visually observed, providing an age estimate. Therefore it represents an ideal astrophysical test-bed for the study of cosmic-ray acceleration and related phenomena.

arxiv-2209-01401.title: Vision Transformers and YoloV5 based Driver Drowsiness Detection Framework
arxiv-2209-01401.creator: Ghanta Sai Krishna 1 , Kundrapu Supriya 2 , Jai Vardhan 3 and Mallikharjuna Rao K 4
arxiv-2209-01401.description: Abstract Human drivers have distinct driving techniques, knowledge, and sentiments due to unique driving traits. Driver drowsiness has been a serious issue endangering road safety; therefore, it is essential to design an effective drowsiness detection algorithm to bypass road accidents.

arxiv-2210-00071.title: A TIME-EFFICIENT, DATA-DRIVEN MODELLING APPROACH FOR PREDICTING THE GEOMAGNETIC IMPACT OF CORONAL MASS EJECTIONS Journal: ApJL
arxiv-2210-00071.creator: Souvik Roy, Dibyendu Nandy
arxiv-2210-00071.description: Abstract To understand the global-scale physical processes behind coronal mass ejection (CME)-driven geomagnetic storms and predict their intensity as a space weather forecasting measure, we develop an interplanetary CME flux rope-magnetosphere interaction module using 3D magnetohydrodynamics. The simulations adequately describe ICME-forced dynamics of the magnetosphere including the imposed magnetotail torsion.

arxiv-2305-02283.title: Baler - Machine Learning Based Compression of Scientific Data
arxiv-2305-02283.creator: F. Bengtsson, C. Doglioni, P.A. Ekman, A. Gallén, P. Jawahar, A. Orucevic-Alagic, M. Camps Santasmasas, N. Skidmore, O. Woolland
arxiv-2305-02283.description: Abstract Storing and sharing increasingly large datasets is a challenge across scientific research and industry. In this paper, we document the development and applications of Baler - a Machine Learning based data compression tool for use across scientific disciplines and industry.

arxiv-2308-03825.title: “Do Anything Now”: Characterizing and Evaluating In-The-Wild Jailbreak Prompts on Large Language Models
arxiv-2308-03825.creator: Xinyue Shen Zeyuan Chen Michael Backes Yun Shen Yang Zhang
arxiv-2308-03825.description: Abstract The misuse of large language models (LLMs) has drawn significant attention from the general public and LLM vendors. One particular type of adversarial prompt, known as jailbreak prompt , has emerged as the main attack vector to bypass the safeguards and elicit harmful content from LLMs.

arxiv-2312-12866.title: Light-responsive active particles in a thermotropic liquid crystal
arxiv-2312-12866.creator: Antonio Tavera-Vázquez 1, Andrés Córdoba 1, Sam Rubin 1, Vincenzo Vitelli 2,3, Juan J. de Pablo 1,4
arxiv-2312-12866.description: Abstract The development of synthetic microswimmers has advanced our understanding of the fundamental self-propelled mechanisms of living systems. However, there are scarce studies at the microscale within highly structured anisotropic media, such as bacteria or cellular receptors that swim in concentrated solutions of filamentous proteins or lipids with viscoelastic properties.

arxiv-2502-01337.title: Neural Preconditioning Operator for Efficient PDE Solves
arxiv-2502-01337.creator: Zhihao Li, Di Xiao, Zhilu Lai, Wei Wang
arxiv-2502-01337.description: Abstract We introduce the Neural Preconditioning Operator (NPO), a novel approach designed to accelerate Krylov solvers in solving large, sparse linear systems derived from partial differential equations (PDEs). Unlike classical preconditioners that often require extensive tuning and struggle to generalize across different meshes or parameters, NPO employs neural operators trained via condition and residual losses.

arxiv-2504-02792.title: Unified World Models: Coupling Video and Action Diffusion for Pretraining on Large Robotic Datasets
arxiv-2504-02792.creator: Chuning Zhu 2 , Raymond Yu 2 , Siyuan Feng 3 , Benjamin Burchfiel 3 , Paarth Shah 3 , and Abhishek Gupta 2
arxiv-2504-02792.description: Abstract Imitation learning has emerged as a promising approach towards building generalist robots. However, scaling imitation learning for large robot foundation models remains challenging due to its reliance on high-quality expert demonstrations. Meanwhile, large amounts of video data depicting a wide range of environments and diverse behaviors are readily available.

arxiv-2508-05498.title: GRAIL: Learning to Interact with Large Knowledge Graphs for Retrieval Augmented Reasoning
arxiv-2508-05498.creator: Ge Chang, Jinbo Su, Jiacheng Liu, Pengfei Yang, Yuhao Shang, Huiwen Zheng, Hongli Ma, Yan Liang, Yuanchun Li, Yunxin Liu
arxiv-2508-05498.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) integrated with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques have exhibited remarkable performance across a wide range of domains. However, existing RAG approaches primarily operate on unstructured data and demonstrate limited capability in handling structured knowledge such as knowledge graphs.

arxiv-2510-23776.title: Unsupervised learning for variability detection with Gaia DR3 photometry
arxiv-2510-23776.creator: P. Ranaivomanana, C. Johnston, G. Iorio, P.J. Groot, M. Uzundag, T. Kupfer, C. Aerts
arxiv-2510-23776.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by P. Ranaivomanana, C. Johnston, G. Iorio, P.J. Groot, M. Uzundag, T. Kupfer, C. Aerts. The unprecedented volume and quality of data from space- and ground-based telescopes present an opportunity for machine learning to identify new classes of variable stars and peculiar systems that may have been overlooked by traditional methods. The region between the main sequence and white-dwarf sequence in the colour–magnitude diagram (CMD) hosts a variety of astrophysically valuable and poorly characterised objects, including hot subdwarfs, pre-white dwarfs, and interacting binaries.

arxiv-2602-10718.title: SnapMLA: Efficient Long-Context MLA Decoding via Hardware-Aware FP8 Quantized Pipelining
arxiv-2602-10718.creator: Yifan Zhang Zunhai Su Shuhao Hu Rui Yang, Wei Wu Yulei Qian Yuchen Xie Xunliang Cai
arxiv-2602-10718.description: Abstract While FP8 attention has shown substantial promise in innovations like FlashAttention-3, its integration into the decoding phase of the DeepSeek Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) architecture presents notable challenges. These challenges include numerical heterogeneity arising from the decoupling of positional embeddings, misalignment of quantization scales in FP8 PV GEMM, and the need for optimized system-level support.

europmc-pmc11426197.title: PM<sub>2.5</sub> polluters disproportionately and systemically affect people of color in the United States.

pmc-10604986.title: Next-Generation Sequencing Analysis of Mutations in Circulating Tumor DNA from the Plasma of Patients with Head–Neck Cancer Undergoing Chemo-Radiotherapy Using a Pan-Cancer Cell-Free Assay
pmc-10604986.creator: Michael I Koukourakis, Erasmia Xanthopoulou, Ioannis M Koukourakis, Sotirios P Fortis, Nikolaos Kesesidis, Christos Kakouratos, Ioannis Karakasiliotis, Constantin N Baxevanis
pmc-10604986.description: Using next-generation sequencing (NGS), we investigated DNA mutations in the plasma tumor cell-free circulating DNA (ctDNA) of 38 patients with inoperable squamous cell head neck cancer (SCHNC) before and after the completion of chemoradiotherapy (CRT). Baseline mutations of the TP53 were recorded in 10/38 (26.3%) and persisted in 4/10 patients after CRT.

pmc-10669118.title: Synthesis and Biological Evaluation of Benzo [4,5]- and Naphtho[2′,1′:4,5]imidazo[1,2-c]pyrimidinone Derivatives
pmc-10669118.creator: Polina Kamzeeva, Nikolai Dagaev, Sofia Lizunova, Yuri Khodarovich, Anna Sogomonyan, Anastasia Kolchanova, Vadim Pokrovsky, Vera Alferova, Alexey Chistov, Artur Eshtukov-Shcheglov, Elizaveta Eshtukova-Shcheglova, Evgeny Belyaev, Dmitry Skvortsov, Anna Varizhuk, Andrey Aralov
pmc-10669118.description: Azacarbazoles have attracted significant interest due to their valuable properties, such as anti-pathogenic and antitumor activity. In this study, a series of structurally related tricyclic benzo[4,5]- and tertacyclic naphtho[2′,1′:4,5]imidazo[1,2-c]pyrimidinone derivatives with one or two positively charged tethers were synthesized and evaluated for anti-proliferative activity.

pmc-10693120.title: A pan-cancer analysis indicates long noncoding RNA HAND2-AS1 as a potential prognostic, immunomodulatory and therapeutic biomarker in various cancers including colorectal adenocarcinoma
pmc-10693120.creator: Pouria Samadi, Mina Shahnazari, Abolfazl Shekari, Fatemeh Maghool, Akram Jalali
pmc-10693120.description: The HAND2-AS1 (HAND2 Antisense RNA 1) Long noncoding RNA (lncRNA) has emerged as a participant in the initiation of various cancer types, underscoring its pivotal involvement in both oncological processes and immune responses. To gain deeper insights into the functional nuances of HAND2-AS1 and identify novel avenues for cancer immunotherapy, a comprehensive evaluation of this gene was undertaken.

pmc-12560424.title: Effects of using auto flow factor function on hemodialysis efficacy in regular hemodialysis patients
pmc-12560424.creator: Said S A Khamis, Ahmed Ragheeb Tawfeek, Mohammed Fathy Ragab, Heba Kamal Abd elkhalk
pmc-12560424.description: BackgroundRecent HD systems have moved from pre-defined dialysate flow rates (e.g. 300, 500, 800 mL/min) to an individual setting, or an automatic adjustment with a fixed factor of the dialysate flow to the blood flow. Both allows more flexibility of choosing the appropriate dialysate flow as an optimal adjustment to the current blood flow.

pmc-12626892.title: Mitotic entry is controlled by the plant-specific phosphatase BSL1 and cyclin-dependent kinase B
pmc-12626892.creator: Frej Tulin, Yalikunjiang Aizezi, Andres V. Reyes, Yuji Fujieda, Arthur Grossman, Shou-ling Xu, Masayuki Onishi, Farhah F. Assaad, Zhi-Yong Wang
pmc-12626892.description: Cell cycle regulation is well understood in opisthokonts (fungi and metazoans) but not in plants or Apicomplexa, as some cell cycle regulators are not conserved. In opisthokonts, cell cycle progression requires the dephosphorylation of cyclin-dependent kinase (CDK) by the CDC25 phosphatase. Plants have no CDC25, and thus their mechanisms of cell cycle regulation remain elusive.

pmc-13188566.title: Comparative analysis of the transcriptome and methylome in distinct trophoblast populations at the time of embryo implantation in mares
pmc-13188566.creator: Joanna Jaworska, Dawid Tobolski, Shebl E Salem, Katarzyna Ropka-Molik, Tomasz Ząbek, Tomasz Szmatoła, Anne Kahler, Izabela Wocławek-Potocka, Katarzyna Piórkowska, Amanda M de Mestre
pmc-13188566.description: BackgroundDuring equine implantation, two distinct trophoblast subpopulations are identified: the invasive chorionic girdle (CG) and the non-invasive allantochorion. The invasive CG trophoblast is believed to modulate the maternal immune response and facilitates embryo attachment to the endometrium, while the allantochorion contributes to placental development without breaching the endometrium.

pmc-13267623.title: Potential of ultrasonication to produce low-salt surimi from blue mussel (Mytilus edulis) meat
pmc-13267623.creator: M Moghadam, TR Heyn, K Schwarz, JK Keppler
pmc-13267623.description: Blue mussel (Mytilus edulis) is a promising sustainable alternative protein source due to its high protein content and minimal environmental impact. The application of mussel myofibrillar proteins (MPs) in surimi products is limited due to poor solubility under low-salt conditions.

pmc-13350370.title: The Complex Relationship Between Clinical Obesity and Heart Failure
pmc-13350370.creator: Jinxia Zhang, Cheng Liu
pmc-13350370.description: Corresponding AuthorKey Words: cardiovascular risk, clinical obesity, heart failure, metabolic syndrome, mortality Obesity has become one of the biggest public health challenges of the 21st century.1 In the traditional definition of obesity, body mass index (BMI) is commonly used as an assessment criterion.

pmc-13359809.title: Head-to-Head Comparison of [68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 PET Interpreted with Non-Contrast CT Versus Excretory-Phase CT Urography in Biochemical Recurrence of Prostate Cancer
pmc-13359809.creator: Vicky Betech-Antar, Juan J. Rosales, Fernando Mínguez, Marta Romera, Luis Fuertes, Fernando Díez-Caballero, Bernardino Miñana-López, Rafael Martinez-Monge, Edgar F. Guillen, Macarena Rodríguez-Fraile
pmc-13359809.description: Simple Summary[68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 PET/CT is widely used to evaluate biochemical recurrence after radical prostatectomy. However, physiological urinary tracer excretion may hamper the assessment of the surgical bed and peri-ureteric lymph nodes. This study evaluated whether adding an excretory-phase CT urography acquisition improves interpretation by facilitating ureteral visualization.
